beats.lead: The story says Salem burned its witches
beats.note: None of the condemned was burned at the stake. The idea likely comes from European trials, where fire was common. Salem followed English law and used the gallows.

beats.context: Fourteen women and five men were hanged between 10 June and 22 September 1692.

beats.lead: One more man died in a different way
beats.text: Giles Corey was pressed to death.
beats.note: He was 81. He refused to enter a plea, so stones were piled on him in September 1692.

beats.text: The fire belongs to Europe. Salem used rope.

beats.line: Check the myth against the record.
